provenance.note: Editorial compilation: every fact referenced here carries its own source, date and flag in the claim register (claims.json), curated in docs/waterways/cooum/waterway-curation.json and gated by scripts/verify_waterway_cooum.py + the numeric audit. Empty sources by design - per-claim citations carry accountability.

attribution.osm: Centerline and width measurement derived from OpenStreetMap (ODbL).
attribution.sentinel: Chips and corridor metrics contain modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026).

timeline.label: Earliest recorded proposal to clean the river, as recorded by Madras Musings
Cooum Improvement Scheme inaugurated by CM C.N. Annadurai
timeline.source: Madras Musings Vol. XXXII No. 8; The Federal

timeline.label: Pleasure boat service with seven jetties; the experiment ended when the sand pump developed snags
Chennai City River Conservation Project: interceptors, pumping and four STPs across six waterways; CMWSSB records all works completed, TN Department of Environment records Rs 395.67 crore spent
timeline.source: CMWSSB CCRCP page (via Internet Archive); TN Dept of Environment NRCP page

timeline.label: Adyar Poonga Trust renamed Chennai Rivers Restoration Trust, with a remit over the Cooum, Adyar, Kosasthalaiyar and Buckingham Canal
timeline.source: CAG of India, Report No. 4 of 2017, para 3.3.1

timeline.label: GoTN directs CRRT to prepare the Cooum restoration DPR
timeline.source: CAG of India, Report No. 4 of 2017, para 3.3.2

timeline.label: Integrated Cooum River Eco-Restoration Plan submitted: 69 sub-projects prepared by LKS India for CRRT, approved by the CRRT Board on 16 July 2014
Administrative sanction for the 60 short-term ICRERP sub-projects across seven agencies, Rs 181.85 crore of it for resettlement
NGT orders compensation for pollution of the Cooum, Adyar and Buckingham Canal
timeline.source: The News Minute; DT Next (Feb 2019); case number unconfirmed

timeline.label: Sanction for continuous opening of the river mouth and desilting, mouth to Napier Bridge
timeline.source: G.O.(Ms) No.76, MAWS (MC-I), 31 Jul 2020, cited in the GoTN status report in NGT O.A. 265 of 2016

timeline.label: CRZ clearance for the Cooum mouth training walls, with a mandated three-year fisheries study and salinity watch
MAWS Policy Note records the ICRERP sanction and disbursement, with all works expected complete by October 2024 except remaining resettlement
timeline.amount: Rs 735.08 crore sanctioned / Rs 572.58 crore disbursed
timeline.source: TN MAWS Department Policy Note 2024-25, para 8.2.1

timeline.label: MAWS Policy Note 2025-26 records Rs 604.75 crore disbursed against the Rs 735.08 crore sanction; all restoration works 'expected to be completed soon'
timeline.source: TN MAWS Department Policy Note 2025-26, para 8.2.1

timeline.label: Supreme Court (S. Rajeshwari v. State of Tamil Nadu, 11 Feb 2026) modifies the Cooum encroachment-removal directions: a joint Revenue-PWD inspection with notice and objections within four months, with status quo on demolition and further construction meanwhile
timeline.source: Supreme Court order of 11 Feb 2026 in civil appeals from SLP(C) 6184/2024 and 7849/2024

timeline.label: Revised Budget announces global tenders and a fresh DFR and DPR for rejuvenating the Cooum and the Adyar
timeline.source: Revised Budget Estimates 2026-27, speech to the Legislative Assembly, 5 Aug 2026 (Dr. N. Marie Wilson, Minister for Finance, Planning and Development)
